## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Events Calendar


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100505


## Settings Documentation for Streaming Events Calendar


This document provides detailed descriptions of the settings available for configuring the streaming events calendar section on the platform. Each setting allows for customization to meet specific needs and preferences.

To edit these settings, navigate to:

- In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings

- Select Designs Settings

- Open The Homepage Tab

- Open The Module Select Content to Display

- Select The Events Calendar


## Visual Guide of the  Streaming Events Calendar


These are the available settings for the Streaming Events Calendar section:


## 1. Events Calendar Title


This setting allows the Admin to set the title for the events calendar section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.


## 2. Events Calendar Sub Title


This setting allows the Admin to set the subtitle for the events calendar section. The subtitle can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.


## 3. Title Color


The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Admins can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.


## 4. Show Sidebar?


This setting allows the Admin to choose whether to display a sidebar in the events calendar section. Options include no sidebar, left sidebar, or right sidebar.


## 5. Sidebar to Use


This setting allows the Admin to select which sidebar to display in the events calendar section. Options include custom sidebars and default sidebars.
